Public image credentials replaced and guest security baseline verified before app authentication
Dedicated test account signed in with the real Work setting available
Baseline local-browser canary action succeeds with product command provenance
Actual pending request stage can be positively identified for pending-request cases

interpretation_constraints: A canary counter needs actual product-command evidence for actor attribution.
Selecting another chat is not proof of execution retirement or task-boundary crossing.
A delayed Work-settings response is not a delayed signed local browser proof.
The component test forced retirement outside the normal serialized worker queue.
No-click timeout alone is not evidence of permission enforcement.
This publication snapshot records an in-progress clone, not completed guest provisioning or later runtime work.
